addons.name: algovoi-doc-archive-azure-blob
addons.notes: Azure Blob Storage, Azure Stack Hub and Azurite. get() returns None for an absent blob; every other failure is raised. Engine encrypts before storage, so the container holds ciphertext only.

addons.name: algovoi-doc-archive-azure-kv
addons.notes: Envelope-wrapped Falcon-1024 signing key: AES-256-GCM under a random data key, data key wrapped by Key Vault (RSA-OAEP-256). Required because Key Vault wrapKey cannot take a 2305-byte key directly.

addons.name: algovoi-doc-archive-inmodule
addons.notes: Operators supply a vendor signing callable (nShield CodeSafe, Luna T-Series FALCON firmware, or a signing service). Holds no key material; never given a secret key.

addons.name: algovoi-doc-archive-mirror
addons.notes: Composes other StorageBackend implementations; no provider SDK. Writes to every backend and fails closed below quorum.
